explanation: Combined result of two independent utils changes. analysisState.ts types the study snapshot's filters as StudyFilters from crossdataset/studySelectionLink.ts (a type-only import) and drops hasStudyAnalysis, whose rule moved into selectionLink; parseStudyAnalysis and the version-1 field set are unchanged, so existing analysis= links parse as before. exportProvenance.ts gains AtlasSubject, AtlasExportKind and atlasExportProvenance for HypoMap atlas files (release tag, manifest SHA-256, cohort and gene, with explicit absences); exportName accepts the atlas subject, provenanceColumns writes AtlasRelease, AtlasManifestSHA256, ExpressionUnit and ExportMetadataJSON for it, and csv.ts accepts that snapshot.
